description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Perform a charged attack at the cost of STA, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Perform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air at the cost of STA, dealing Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to counterattack, dealing Spectro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Melakukan serangan terisi dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Melakukan Plunging Attack di udara dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang balik, memberikan Spectro DMG.

description.en:
Dash forward and perform consecutive strikes that inflict Spectro DMG.

Overflowing Radiance
After Jinhsi uses Basic Attack 4 or, while not in Incarnation, Intro Skill Loong's Halo, an alternative Resonance Skill Overflowing Radiance is available within 5s.
Resonance Skill Overflowing Radiance inflicts Spectro DMG and sends Jinhsi into Incarnation.
Can be cast in mid-air.
description.id:
Melesat ke depan dan melakukan serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG.

Overflowing Radiance
Setelah Jinhsi menggunakan Basic Attack 4 atau, saat tidak dalam Incarnation, Intro Skill Loong's Halo, Resonance Skill alternatif Overflowing Radiance tersedia dalam 5 dtk.
Resonance Skill Overflowing Radiance memberikan Spectro DMG dan membuat Jinhsi memasuki Incarnation.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

description.en:
Unleash the power of invocation to deal Spectro DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.
description.id:
Melepaskan kekuatan invokasi untuk memberikan Spectro DMG.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

description.en: DMG Multiplier of Intro Skill Loong's Halo is increased by 50%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Intro Skill Loong's Halo meningkat sebesar 50%.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

Incarnation

While in Incarnation:
- Alternative Basic Attack "Incarnation - Basic Attack" becomes available. Perform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing Spectro DMG considered as Resonance Skill DMG. The basic attack cycle of this will not be reset. Can be cast in mid-air.
- Alternative Resonance Skill "Crescent Divinity" becomes available. Deal Spectro DMG. Can be cast in mid-air.
- Alternative Heavy Attack "Incarnation - Heavy Attack" becomes available. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing Spectro DMG.
- Alternative Dodge "Incarnation - Dodge" is available while in mid-air. Can be cast multiple times at the cost of Stamina.
- Alternative Dodge Counter "Incarnation - Dodge Counter" becomes available. Deal Spectro DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany

After Stage 4 of Incarnation - Basic Attack, Incarnation terminates and Jinhsi gains Ordination Glow.
Can be cast in mid-air.
While Ordination Glow lasts:
- Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack "Incarnation - Heavy Attack". Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing Spectro DMG.
- Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill "Illuminous Epiphany". Send out Solar Flare that detonates as Stella Glamor, dealing Spectro DMG after a short delay. Consume up to 50 Incandescence, with each point of Incandescence granting bonus DMG Multiplier percentage to Stella Glamor.
Can be cast in mid-air.
- After casting Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany, Jinhsi gains Unison. This can be triggered once every 25s.

Unison

While Jinhsi has Unison, switching to other Resonators will remove Jinhsi's Unison to trigger Jinhsi's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. Unison will be consumed in priority in place of Concerto Energy when Concerto Energy is full.

Incandescence

Jinhsi can hold up to 50 Incandescence.
When Jinhsi is in the party, all nearby Resonators in the party gain Eras in Unity.
Eras in Unity provides 2 independent effects:
Jinhsi gains 1 Incandescence anytime Resonators in the party inflict Attribute DMG. This effect may be triggered by damage of the same Attribute for up to 1 time(s) every 3s. Additionally, Jinhsi gains 2 Incandescence when Resonators in the party damage the enemy with Coordinated Attacks. This effect may be triggered by Coordinated Attacks of the same Attribute for up to 1 time(s) every 3s.
description.id:
Incarnation

Selama dalam Incarnation:
- Basic Attack alternatif "Incarnation - Basic Attack" tersedia. Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG. Siklus basic attack ini tidak akan di-reset. Dapat dilancarkan di udara.
- Resonance Skill alternatif "Crescent Divinity" tersedia. Memberikan Spectro DMG. Dapat dilancarkan di udara.
- Heavy Attack alternatif "Incarnation - Heavy Attack" tersedia. Menyerang target di udara dengan mengonsumsi Stamina, memberikan Spectro DMG.
- Dodge alternatif "Incarnation - Dodge" tersedia saat di udara. Dapat dilancarkan berkali-kali dengan mengonsumsi Stamina.
- Dodge Counter alternatif "Incarnation - Dodge Counter" tersedia. Memberikan Spectro DMG.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany

Setelah Tahap 4 Incarnation - Basic Attack, Incarnation berakhir dan Jinhsi mendapat Ordination Glow.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.
Selama Ordination Glow berlangsung:
- Basic Attack digantikan oleh Heavy Attack "Incarnation - Heavy Attack". Menyerang target di udara dengan mengonsumsi Stamina, memberikan Spectro DMG.
- Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Resonance Skill "Illuminous Epiphany". Melepaskan Solar Flare yang meledak sebagai Stella Glamor, memberikan Spectro DMG setelah jeda singkat. Mengonsumsi hingga 50 Incandescence, dengan setiap poin Incandescence memberikan persentase pengali DMG tambahan pada Stella Glamor.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.
- Setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany, Jinhsi mendapat Unison. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 25 dtk.

Unison

Saat Jinhsi memiliki Unison, berganti ke Resonator lain akan menghapus Unison Jinhsi untuk mengaktifkan Outro Skill Jinhsi dan Intro Skill Resonator yang masuk. Unison akan dikonsumsi lebih dulu menggantikan Concerto Energy saat Concerto Energy penuh.

Incandescence

Jinhsi dapat menyimpan hingga 50 Incandescence.
Saat Jinhsi berada di tim, seluruh Resonator tim di sekitar mendapat Eras in Unity.
Eras in Unity memberikan 2 efek independen:
Jinhsi mendapat 1 Incandescence setiap kali Resonator di tim memberikan Attribute DMG. Efek ini dapat dipicu oleh damage dengan Attribute yang sama hingga 1 kali setiap 3 dtk. Selain itu, Jinhsi mendapat 2 Incandescence saat Resonator di tim melukai musuh dengan Coordinated Attack. Efek ini dapat dipicu oleh Coordinated Attack dengan Attribute yang sama hingga 1 kali setiap 3 dtk.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Summoning the power homologous with the Sentinel, Jinhsi may now gain Incandescence via Eras in Unity from damage of the same Attribute more effectively, at 1 time(s) every 1s for 20s.
description.id: Memanggil kekuatan yang sejalan dengan Sentinel, Jinhsi kini dapat memperoleh Incandescence melalui Eras in Unity dari damage dengan Attribute yang sama secara lebih efektif, yaitu 1 kali setiap 1 dtk selama 20 dtk.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: When casting Basic Attack "Incarnation - Basic Attack" or Resonance Skill Crescent Divinity, Jinhsi gains one stack of Herald of Revival, stacking up to 4 times and lasting for 6s. When casting Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany, Jinhsi consumes all stacks of Herald of Revival. Each stack increases the damage of Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany by 20%.
description.id: Saat melancarkan Basic Attack "Incarnation - Basic Attack" atau Resonance Skill Crescent Divinity, Jinhsi mendapat satu stack Herald of Revival, bertumpuk hingga 4 kali dan bertahan selama 6 dtk. Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany, Jinhsi mengonsumsi semua stack Herald of Revival. Setiap stack meningkatkan damage Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany sebesar 20%.

description.en: Jinhsi restores 50 Incandescence while staying out of combat for more than 4s. This effect can only be triggered 1 time(s) every 4s.
description.id: Jinhsi memulihkan 50 Incandescence saat berada di luar pertempuran lebih dari 4 dtk. Efek ini hanya dapat aktif 1 kali setiap 4 dtk.

description.en: Jinhsi gains one stack of Immortal's Descendancy after casting Intro Skill Loong's Halo. Each stack of Immortal's Descendancy increases Jinhsi's ATK by 25%, stacking up to 2 time(s) and lasting for 20s.
description.id: Jinhsi mendapat satu stack Immortal's Descendancy setelah melancarkan Intro Skill Loong's Halo. Setiap stack Immortal's Descendancy meningkatkan ATK Jinhsi sebesar 25%, bertumpuk hingga 2 kali dan bertahan selama 20 dtk.

description.en: When Jinhsi casts Resonance Liberation Purge of Light or Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany, all nearby Resonators on the team gain 20% Attribute DMG Bonus for 20s.
description.id: Saat Jinhsi melancarkan Resonance Liberation Purge of Light atau Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany, seluruh Resonator tim di sekitar mendapat 20% Attribute DMG Bonus selama 20 dtk.

description.en: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Purge of Light is increased by 120%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Purge of Light meningkat sebesar 120%.

description.en: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany is increased by 45% and the additional DMG Multiplier gained by consuming Incandescence is increased by 45%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany meningkat sebesar 45% dan pengali DMG tambahan dari mengonsumsi Incandescence meningkat sebesar 45%.
